Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

The admission view-model explicitly obtains display counts through studio-core LedgerCounts and applies its own equation presentation. That keeps the arithmetic typed and tested at the presentation seam, but it does not satisfy the ticket’s preferred authoritative backend total with a StudioRef, nor is there an owner decision accepting presentation arithmetic. Keep the bead open for a clear choice: serve total/equation evidence from eyes4s, or record a deliberate exception and document why the view-layer sum is acceptable.

Evidence:
- studio/app/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/app/admission/AdmissionLedgerVM.scala:318
- studio/core/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/selection/LedgerCounts.scala:49
- studio/app/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/app/admission/AdmissionLedger.scala:135

Remaining / next action: Serve authoritative totals/refs or make and record the explicit presentation-arithmetic decision.

Disposition: Keep open.
